claim_scores.rationale: Defines `BaseQA` with one input (`question`) and one output (`answer`), then derives new signatures via `prepend`/`append` on that base signature.
Prepends input `context` to the input section and asserts `list(sig.input_fields.keys()) == ["context", "question"]`.
Prepends output `reasoning` before `answer`, appends `confidence` after it, and asserts `list(sig.output_fields.keys()) == ["reasoning", "answer", "confidence"]`.
Uses DSPy’s ordered mappings `sig.input_fields` and `sig.output_fields` to verify preserved insertion order directly.
Renders `system_message` via `ChatAdapter().format_system_message(sig)`, prints it, and asserts ordered field-name positions within the rendered text.
